items.title: Bud Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-28
items.q: I think his mother's Irish and his father's Italian.

ctx.x: Yeah. A lot of people like that, uh, Tony Spavaro.
I think his mother's Irish and his father's Italian.

And, uh, what faith did they bring you up in? Catholic. Mm-hmm. Did you hear any music in church? No. Didn't have much music in church? No. The reason I ask is because it seems like they take the church music and jazz it up. Now, you know? Yeah, no. They're doing that to a lot of the old hymns. Never had none to that, I can remember.
